name: AR6
source_name: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, WG1 Chapter 7: CH4 and N2O from Table 7.15 (with chemical adjustments), halocarbons and SF6 from Table 7.SM.7, 100-year GWP
notes: Read from the published tables on 2026-09-25. Table 7.15 separates fossil from non-fossil methane and includes the chemical adjustments, so it is used for CH4 and N2O. Halocarbons and SF6 are taken from Table 7.SM.7 so that they share one basis; that table excludes the carbon-cycle response, which is why HFC-134a is 1,530 here and 1,526 in Table 7.15. The difference is far inside the table's own uncertainty range.
